summary: The instrument index contains numerous entries with non-standard or incomplete tag numbers, incorrect instrument type classifications, generic or low-confidence service descriptions, and missing critical data such as line tags and categories. The AI frequently defaults to 'Soft Link' for IO type and 'Panel' for location, indicating a lack of specific extraction for field devices.

comments.issue: Instrument type 'BLEED' is not a standard ISA S5.1 classification.
comments.suggested_value: Manual review required to determine correct instrument type based on P&ID symbol.
comments.reason: Using non-standard instrument types leads to inconsistencies and difficulties in data management and reporting.

comments.issue: Tag number 'CC' is incomplete; it represents only the instrument type, not a full tag with a loop number.
comments.suggested_value: Extract full tag number from P&ID.
comments.reason: Incomplete tag numbers prevent proper identification and tracking of instruments.

comments.issue: Category is missing for instrument type 'CC'.
comments.suggested_value: controller
comments.reason: Missing categories hinder proper classification and filtering of instruments.
comments.evidence_needed: ISA S5.1 standard or project legend.

comments.issue: Location 'Panel' is unlikely for a field element (FE).
comments.suggested_value: Field
comments.reason: Incorrect location can lead to errors in installation, maintenance, and material take-offs.
comments.evidence_needed: P&ID symbol location or project legend.

comments.issue: Critical line tag is missing for a field-mounted emergency shutdown hand switch.
comments.suggested_value: Extract line tag from P&ID.
comments.reason: Missing line tags prevent proper tracing of instrument connections and impact MTOs and piping design.
comments.evidence_needed: P&ID drawing showing instrument connection to a line.

comments.evidence_needed: ISA S5.1 standard or project legend for instrument types.
